name: Afterflow
description: a predictive input cheat that fixes your early clicks and makes them accurate.

terminal-enabled.name: enable terminal
terminal-enabled.description: allow the terminal key to open the afterflow log window

show-shift-hud.name: show tick shift on screen
show-shift-hud.description: briefly show the tick shift applied to each corrected input at the top of the screen. note: this is part of the game view, so it appears in recordings

show-correction-markers.name: show correction markers
show-correction-markers.description: draw a colored dot in the level where each input was shifted: green small, yellow medium, red large. note: this is part of the game view, so it appears in recordings

show-combo.name: show save counter
show-combo.description: show a 1x, 2x, 3x counter that pops each time an input is saved. resets every attempt. appears in recordings

combo-sound.name: save counter sound
combo-sound.description: play a sound on each save that rises in pitch as the counter goes up

show-correction-replay.name: show correction replay
show-correction-replay.description: after a save, draw the ghost path for the uncorrected input (red) next to the corrected one (green) for 3 seconds. appears in recordings

log-level.name: terminal log level
log-level.description: quiet: attempt summary and errors only. normal: every save. verbose: also the detailed prediction traces

show-ghost-race.name: show ghost race
show-ghost-race.description: after a save, a ghost dot runs the uncorrected path next to you. appears in recordings

show-timeline.name: show click timeline
show-timeline.description: strip at the bottom of the screen comparing when you clicked and when the input landed. appears in recordings

show-bias.name: show early / late readout
show-bias.description: small text with your average click offset this attempt. appears in recordings

danger-preview.name: danger glow
danger-preview.description: glow on the player when a click right now would die. runs a short prediction a few times a second. appears in recordings

show-medals.name: show streak medals
show-medals.description: medal and screen edge pulse at 5, 10, 25 and 50 saves in one attempt. appears in recordings

combo-sound-pack.name: counter sound pack
combo-sound-pack.description: which sound plays on each save

combo-volume.name: counter volume
combo-volume.description: volume of the save counter sound

theme.name: menu theme
theme.description: accent color of the afterflow menu

keybinds-title.name: keybinds
keybinds-title.description: change geodes keybinding anytime for afterflow

keybind-terminal.name: terminal
keybind-terminal.description: open or close the afterflow terminal

keybind-menu.name: menu
keybind-menu.description: open or close the afterflow menu (set to the apostrophe key on first launch)
